## What this is

One row per capability the project currently asserts, mapped to the named gate, test or walk-check identity that goes red when the claim stops being true. A row with no such check renders in the **UNPROVEN** section below with the check that needs to exist — stated, never softened. Rows quote RECORDED evidence with its own as-of date; volatile counts live in the files that move, not here.

Proof classes, kept apart:

- `SESSION_MEASURED` — observed by the implementing session's own run.
- `INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED` — reproduced by a canonical suite or audit execution separate from the implementation's one-off proving observation, against a committed integration head or later, via the normal reader/audit path, never a purpose-built fixture encoding the expected result.

Reader-facing runs also record their target: `LOCAL_RENDER` (a local production build, RULING 125) or `PRODUCTION_RENDER` (the deployed site).
